usage: Parses Windows Prefetch (.pf) files, which record when programs ran, how often and which files they loaded. Use it to establish program execution and run times.
limitation: Prefetch keeps only the last 8 run times per program and is off by default on Windows Server. A missing file does not prove a program never ran.

parameters.label: Prefetch file
parameters.description: File to process. Either this or -d is required.

parameters.label: Prefetch directory
parameters.description: Directory to recursively process. Either this or -f is required.

parameters.label: Highlight keywords
parameters.description: Comma separated list of keywords to highlight in output. 'temp' and 'tmp' are always highlighted.

parameters.label: Save decompressed bytes to
parameters.description: Save prefetch file bytes to the given path. Useful to look at decompressed Win10 files.
